title: Apartamento T9 em Dúplex com garagem e duas entr

- Local shops

- Schools and university campuses (Hospitality School, Campus 2 and ISEC). The proximity to the main universities and the city center makes this property especially attractive for the student rental market.

If you are looking for a spacious, versatile property with an excellent location in Coimbra, this is a rare opportunity on the market.
